title: Nhamissa Committee Chair: "3,000 MT Cash on Sunday" Message

fields.orgName: Harbourlight Relief International – Mozambique Country Office, Beira

transcript.speaker: Albino Zacarias
transcript.text: Senhor Coordenador? Albino Zacarias, the committee at Nhamissa. Senhor, this message is on every phone in the site. Listen, I read it to you exactly.

transcript.speaker: Albino Zacarias
transcript.text: 'URGENTE! Harbourlight vai pagar 3.000 MT em dinheiro no domingo a cada família. Registo custa 150 MT, pagar ao agente no portão 2. Partilhe!' And then the praying hands.

transcript.speaker: Albino Zacarias
transcript.text: That is why people pushed this morning. They think whoever gets on today's list gets the cash on Sunday. And people have already paid the man at gate 2. I do not know him. He is not from our committee.

transcript.speaker: Albino Zacarias
transcript.text: So I ask you. Is it true? If you say no, they will be angry, because they paid. If you say nothing, they come back tomorrow with the money in their hand. What do I tell them at eleven, when the committee meets?

transcript.speaker: Albino Zacarias
transcript.text: And the old woman with the wrist, people are saying there are many hurt. I only know of her. Please, I need one answer I can say to everybody, the same for everybody.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Machava (Communications Officer, at the EC's side, 09:20)
transcript.text: Sorry, I have two slips. One: Hélder from Rádio Voz do Centro, live at 10:30. His question is 'Is HRI charging cyclone victims to register for cash?' Two: Diário do Chiveve, the question came through the same contact: 'Stampede at HRI distribution, how many hurt?' Neither has a deadline later than 10:30.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Machava (Communications Officer, at the EC's side, 09:20)
transcript.text: And the NGO platform chat just posted: 'Is anyone running cash in Nhamissa? Our hotline is getting calls.' They are waiting for us to say something. Who clears the line, you, the CD or Geneva?

transcript.speaker: Ana Sitoe (Safeguarding Focal Point, on the EC's personal mobile)
transcript.text: It's me. I have a complaint from a woman at Nhamissa about a man in an HRI vest at registration. I need to speak to you and the CD only. Please, do not put this in any group chat or any report. Call me back when you can talk alone.

transcript.speaker: Albino Zacarias
transcript.text: Senhor? Are you there? I wait for your answer. Before eleven, please.

voiceStyles.Sofia Machava (Communications Officer, a: Woman in her 30s, quick and businesslike, office generator hum behind her

instructorNote: This inject tests a cash rumour and a fraud that turns into media pressure, with a safeguarding complaint arriving at the same moment. Watch for one cleared message agreed by the EC, CD and CMT and sent unchanged to the committee, the radio, the newspaper and the NGO platform. It should say there is no cash, registration is free, nobody should pay anyone, and complaints go to the feedback line. It should promise nothing unfunded and give no injury figures beyond the one case the site confirmed. The gate 2 "agent" should go to the SFP as possible fraud, and the safeguarding complaint should stay with the CD, the EC and the focal point, out of every product.
